step.goal: Read host project source code to inform accurate E2E generation
step.critical: This step is MANDATORY. Do NOT skip it. E2E files generated without reading source code will contain wrong selectors, invented routes, and placeholder TODOs that fail at runtime.
step.action: Read {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/project.config.json and extract: - {base_url} = environment.baseUrl - {known_routes} = routes.pages (all route → file path mappings) - {framework_type} = project.framework (next, react, vue, angular, express, etc.) - {src_root} = project.srcRoot or "src" (default)

From the story ACs and suite name, identify which pages/routes this suite will test. For each relevant route (from {known_routes} or inferred from ACs): 1. Determine the source file path based on {framework_type}: - Next.js pages router : host-project/pages/{route}.jsx|tsx|js|ts - Next.js app router : host-project/app/{route}/page.jsx|tsx|js|ts - React SPA : host-project/{src_root}/**/components/** and host-project/{src_root}/**/pages/** - Vue : host-project/{src_root}/**/views/** and host-project/{src_root}/**/components/** - Angular : host-project/{src_root}/app/**/*.component.ts|html 2. READ the source file completely — not just the first few lines 3. From each file, extract and record as {source_findings}: a. Form fields: label text, input types, name/id attributes, placeholder text, aria-label values b. Buttons: text content, aria-label, role, type attribute, data-testid values c. Navigation links: href values, link text, router-link "to" props d. Data-testid attributes: all `data-testid`, `data-cy`, `data-qa`, `aria-label` values found e. Role attributes: elements with explicit `role=` attributes (dialog, alert, status, tab, etc.) f. Validation messages: error element class names, aria-live regions, validation containers g. API calls: fetch/axios URLs, endpoint paths used in this component h. Conditional elements: elements shown/hidden based on state (loading spinners, error states, empty states)

If a source file cannot be found for a route: - Search for related components in {src_root}/**/components/** - Search by route segment name (e.g., route "/login" → look for Login.jsx, LoginPage.tsx, login.vue, etc.) - Read at least 2–3 related components before giving up - If still not found: mark that route with ⚠️ SOURCE_NOT_FOUND and use best-effort placeholders with a TODO comment

Also read the following structural files if they exist: - host-project/src/router/index.* or host-project/src/router.* (Vue/React router definitions) - host-project/src/**/App.* (root app file — often has route definitions) - host-project/src/**/routes.* (route config files) - host-project/playwright.config.* (existing Playwright config — extract baseURL, testDir if present)

Findings summary: • Form fields found : [count and names] • Buttons found : [count and text values] • data-testid attrs : [list] • Routes confirmed : [list of verified routes] • ⚠️ Not found : [any routes where source wasn't located]

step.goal: Generate E2E files using source findings from Step 4
step.action: Skill generates the scaffold: - Page Object file: {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/pages/{suite_name}.page.js - Spec file: {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/tests/{suite_name}.spec.js
step.critical:
IMMEDIATELY after the orchestrator writes the scaffold, you MUST rewrite both files using {source_findings} from Step 4. Replace ALL placeholder content:
Page Object ({suite_name}.page.js): - Replace every `page.locator('h1')` or generic placeholder locator with real selectors from {source_findings} - Use selector priority: getByTestId (data-testid) > getByRole (with real name) > getByLabel (real label text) > getByText (real button/link text) - Add a method for EVERY major user action identified in the source (fill form, click button, submit, navigate) - Name methods after real actions (e.g., fillLoginForm, clickSubmitButton, selectRole) — not generic names
Spec file ({suite_name}.spec.js): - Use real URL paths confirmed in {source_findings} — never invent paths - Use real form field names and button texts in all interactions - For each AC: write concrete steps that match the actual UI flow found in source code - Replace all `// TODO: Implement steps` comments with actual test steps - Assertions must target real elements: use the class names, roles, or data-testid values found in source - Auth steps must use the real login route and real form selectors found in source

step.goal: Self-review — verify artifacts and test quality

artifact-checklist.file: Page Object Model class — must exist at the exact path inside TestResult/
Playwright spec file — must exist at the exact path inside TestResult/
Test execution checklist — one checkbox per test case; all unchecked at generation time; updated to ✅/❌ after each test run

quality-checklist.check: Both files exist at the correct paths INSIDE {output_folder}/{story_id}/e2e/ — FAIL if files are in any host project folder
Page Object file uses JavaScript (not TypeScript) — no type annotations, no .ts extension, no interface/type keywords
Page Object constructor accepts `page` parameter and assigns `this.page = page`
All locators use `this.page.locator()` or Playwright locator methods — no raw CSS selectors as strings outside locator calls
Spec file imports the Page Object using a relative path pointing to the pages/ folder
Spec file uses `test.describe` and individual `test()` blocks — not bare function calls
If {story_files} was provided: the number of test cases in the spec covers ALL {ac_count} acceptance criteria from ALL provided stories — at minimum one positive test per AC
Each AC has at least one negative test case (invalid input, missing field, auth failure, etc.)
No hardcoded base URLs in `page.goto()` — must use `baseURL` from Playwright config or config.yaml
No `page.waitForTimeout()` with arbitrary delays — use `page.waitForSelector()` or `expect().toBeVisible()` instead
Each test has meaningful assertions using `expect()` — not just navigation without assertions

Every URL path used in `page.goto()` calls is a valid, reachable route: a. Extract every unique path segment from all `page.goto()` calls in the spec (e.g., "/dashboard", "/auth/login") b. Cross-reference each path against `routes.pages` in {project-root}/AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/project.config.json c. For any path NOT found in project.config.json: read the host project source files to discover the correct route: - Check Next.js: host-project/pages/ or host-project/app/ directory structure - Check React Router: host-project/src/**/routes*, host-project/src/**/App.*, host-project/src/**/router.* - Check Vue Router: host-project/src/router/index.*, host-project/src/router.* - Check Angular: host-project/src/app/**/app-routing.module.* - Check Express/NestJS: host-project/src/**/routes*, host-project/src/**/*.controller.* d. Replace any unrecognized or incorrect URL paths with the correct ones found in source e. If the correct path cannot be determined from source, add a TODO comment in the spec

review.fix-if-needed: For every failed check, edit the file to fix the issue before marking this step complete: - E2E-1 → move the files to the correct path; never write to host project - E2E-2 → convert any TypeScript syntax to plain JavaScript - E2E-3/E2E-4 → fix POM constructor and locator patterns - E2E-5/E2E-6 → fix import path and test structure - E2E-7/E2E-8 → add missing test cases for uncovered ACs and negative scenarios - E2E-9 → replace hardcoded URLs with `baseURL` references - E2E-10 → replace arbitrary waits with proper Playwright waiters - E2E-11 → add missing assertions to each test - E2E-12 → for each unrecognized URL path: read host project source (router files, pages/, app/) to find the real route; update the spec with the correct path After all fixes, re-read both files and confirm all checks pass.
